messages:
alex: Heads up — after the weekend deploy I found a case where a user with only the 'viewer' role could save changes to a project snippet. Repro steps below, attaching screenshots in a sec. Anyone seeing related audit noise?

maya: I can repro on staging. quick steps: open project X -> snippets -> edit -> save. UI shows success but backend returns 403 then 200 on retry.

frank: That sounds like the UI permission-gating returned stale role info. We recently changed role aliases in the role matrix mapping (viewer -> read_only). Maybe the client-side cache didn't catch the new alias.

ben: Pasted the tail of the console log: ```2026-03-19T03:12:04Z ERROR permission.check: role_resolver.go:142 mismatch: requested=edit allowed_by_alias=viewer alias=read_only user=uid:ABCD1234 request_id=r-0b3f``` Noting we see a KMS decrypt warning right before: `kms: decrypt failed: key not found (KeyAlias/console-role-matrix)`

janet: From security: if KMS fails decoding role metadata we fallback to legacy role lookup which might incorrectly resolve editor perms. That's a risk. Need triage ASAP.

alex: Good catch. So two things: (1) why did KMS lookups fail for that key id; (2) why does fallback produce an elevated binding?

maya: KMS logs show a permission denied for the service account used by the role-resolver: `projects/ri-prod/serviceAccounts/role-resolver@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. There was a KMS policy push over the weekend tied to key rotation.

frank: If rotation removed that SA's decrypt role temporarily, role metadata couldn't be read, so resolver fell back to legacy mapping table which still maps some viewer aliases to editor in edge cases. I can reproduce with a forced KMS decrypt error.

ben: Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) roll the UI gating to deny-by-default if role metadata unavailable (remove fallback), 2) re-grant decrypt to role-resolver SA, 3) add audit entry for fallback events.

janet: Agree. Also want a list of affected orgs/users — query audit logs for events where action=`snippet.update` && auth_role_resolver=fallback. I'll run a coarse search and share results in #incidents if anything but small.

deploy-bot: deploy: rollback requested by @alex for service=console-role-resolver, env=prod, version=2026.03.19-17:20. Rollback in progress.

oncall-bot: oncall: paging eng-infra and eng-ml for KMS policy restore.

alex: Action items: frank to prepare hotfix to remove fallback behavior (PR), maya to reapply KMS decrypt permission and confirm, janet to run audit query and notify affected customers, ben to add a targeted audit log flag for fallback resolution. Target: hotfix merged + permissions fixed within 3 hours. I'll coordinate with SRE for rollout.

frank: I'll open PR now, link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4982 — removes legacy fallback and adds explicit error tracking.

maya: Restored decrypt permission to role-resolver SA and re-ran a few requests — KMS decrypt now returns 200. Confirming staging repro gone.

janet: Audit query results (prelim): ~24 distinct user sessions across 3 orgs hit fallback path between 2026-03-19T00:00Z and 2026-03-19T04:00Z. I'll DM compliance for notification draft.

ben: Added telemetry: `rbac.fallback_triggered=true` in logs and surfaced in console traces. Also created a short e2e that simulates KMS failure to prevent regression.

alex: Thanks all. Keeping thread open until rollout + audit notify done. Ping me if you need escalations. :thumbsup:
